Amp documentation excerpts, NOT a captured executable help fixture.
Sources: https://ampcode.com/docs/markdown/cli and https://ampcode.com/docs/markdown/threads (retrieved 2026-09-10)

Run amp to start the Amp CLI. Without any arguments, it runs in interactive mode.
To see more of what the CLI can do, run amp --help.
amp --executor local
amp --executor orb
amp --executor runner:grandmas-garage-server

Run amp threads continue T-… to attach the CLI to a thread.
amp threads continue T-…

Source: https://ampcode.com/docs/markdown/tools
Amp does not ask for approval before running tools.
Use a custom plugin to control tool use.
